description: The line plot illustrates the similarity across different layers for three different configurations of a multilingual language model (LLM) as they are expanded. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and is linear, with a value range from 0 to 22, indicating the number of layers in the LLM. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" and is also linear, with a value range from 0.05 to 0.45, representing the degree of similarity between the expanded LLM configurations. There are three lines in the plot, each representing a different configuration: "en&en" in red, "en&el" in blue, and "en&bn" in green. The "en&en" line starts at a similarity of approximately 0.15, peaks at around 0.35, and ends at approximately 0.45. The "en&el" line begins at a similarity of about 0.05, peaks at roughly 0.25, and concludes at around 0.35. The "en&bn" line starts at a similarity of approximately 0.05, peaks at around 0.15, and ends at about 0.25. The plot does not include any markers or line styles, and the lines are solid throughout.
